title: ExpectedContact
description: Golden expected fields for a single calling card (matches OCRResult / LogSheetEntry core fields).

name.description: Person full name including credentials (e.g. Dr. Maria Santos, MD).

company.description: Full registered business name; recombine stacked logo lines.

phone.description: One entry per distinct number; split on / | ,.

address.description: Single address, or Label: addr | Label: addr for multi-address cards.

notes.description: Websites, socials, taglines — pipe-separated. Empty string if none.
